'''Brian Goble''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Parker tournament (6 January)]] on 6 January 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1607">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-08-parker-co-1-6-01-end-of-an-erad1607/ parker-co-1-6-01-end-of-an-era], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 8 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-08-parker-co-1-6-01-end-of-an-erad1607/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
